label: End of episode D2: reached S1 via common a1, in a run of rewarded a1->S1 trials
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when the state input is S1 after choosing a1 (common transition; 1 of 969 activations is otherwise), only in the last ~10 trials of the episode (ep_trial 90-99, all mass), and only when the model value output is low (<5.2, all mass; the value head drops near the episode end). It also requires that the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward=1, all mass) and favors runs of repeated a1->S1c rewarded trials: activation ramps up over consecutive such trials within a window (e.g. 0.1 -> 0.66 -> 0.91 -> 1.0) and is larger the lower the value. Never fires at D1/GO, on S2, after a2, or after an unrewarded previous trial. Simple version (D2 & S1 & a1 & value<4 & prev_reward==1) gets recall ~1.0 but precision 0.39; tightening the value threshold to 3.5 and requiring the two previous trials not to have reached S2 or gone unrewarded gives dev P 0.80 / R 0.72 / mass recall 0.90. Value (a model output) stands in for time-to-episode-end; ep_trial>=95 instead gives lower precision. No future variables used.
